summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP, a Greek-based foreign private issuer, furnished a routine Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, attaching a press release dated September 8, 2026, reporting unaudited results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. Half-year net income was $33.4 million ($0.82 per common unit), adjusted net income $28.2 million ($0.68 per unit), and adjusted EBITDA $51.9 million on 95.7% fleet utilization; quarterly net income was $16.0 million ($0.39 per unit) on 96.2% utilization. Declared distributions, the Clean Energy's new Rio Grande time charter, and a $0.73 billion contracted backlog were noted. No special-situation transaction is present.
